lines.text: Since Christ suffered in His body, believers should live their remaining time for the will of God.
The Gentiles consider it strange when believers will not join their debauchery, and they heap abuse on them.
Those who heap abuse will give an account to Caesar, who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

wrong_details.true: Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead

lines.text: Because the end is near, believers should be sober so they can rest, love deeply, and show hospitality without complaining.
Each believer should use his gift to serve others, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ.
